I'm an engineering student at Harvey Mudd College studying computer architecture, digital logic design, and microprocessor-based systems. As a [Clay-Wolkin Fellow](https://www.hmc.edu/engineering/engineering-fellowships/clay-wolkin-fellowship/), I work on RISC-V certification and design, and at [TRL11](https://www.trl11.com/) I worked on space-qualified networking hardware.
